sonnet.problem: The right answer ('See how his brothers and the flocks are faring') is the longest of the three (9 words against 6 and 6) and the only one that sounds like the Bible ('faring'). The wrong answers read as plain modern phrasing, so the right answer stands out.
sonnet.rule: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. None are silly. ... Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.
